author: bardic-inspiration
name: The Validation Gate
summary: Gargoyles perched on the iron gate at the foot of the stair test everything the party carries.

parts.text: The stair ends at an iron gate twice your height, its bars worked into the shapes of letters. Five stone figures crouch along its top. As you step close, a bell inside the gate rings once, and the figures unfold their wings.

The gate reads everything carried through it and rings when something doesn't fit its schema. It rings for anyone without a reader's card, and the {ref:creature/gargoyle}s attack until the bell stops or they're destroyed. A character who studies the gate and succeeds on a DC 14 Intelligence (Arcana) check learns that it only checks shape, never sense: an entry can pass the gate and still be wrong. That's the gate working as intended, not an anomaly, and one of the Anomaly Ledger's red herrings.
